lead: Flight operations software vendors are actively expanding their product suites and customer portfolios, with Jeppesen, Lufthansa Systems, and Navblue securing major carrier adoptions while rolling out advanced automated dispatch and EFB updates.

insights.title: Royal Air Maroc Selects AvioBook Flight EFB
insights.finding: Royal Air Maroc signed a five-year agreement with Thales to deploy the AvioBook Flight Electronic Flight Bag platform across its operations.
insights.aviation_context: EFB platforms replace paper flight folders and streamline cockpit access to operational documents.

insights.title: Jeppesen Expands ForeFlight with Airflow Agents
insights.finding: Jeppesen introduced Trip Feasibility and Ops Briefing Airflow agents for ForeFlight Dispatch at NBAA-BACE 2026.
insights.aviation_context: Automated dispatch agents assist flight planners with route feasibility and pre-flight briefing tasks.
insights.caveat: Targeted primarily toward business aviation segments.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Deploys Lido Flight 4D for Kenya Airways
insights.finding: Kenya Airways implemented Lufthansa Systems' Lido Flight 4D for integrated flight planning, digital briefing, and fleet visibility.
insights.aviation_context: Flight planning software optimizes fuel burn and trajectory management.

insights.title: Bytron Skybook Releases EFB Version 1.52.0
insights.finding: Bytron Skybook released version 1.52.0 of its EFB and Ground Portal, featuring customizable settings, new checklists, and fuel fields.
insights.aviation_context: EFB updates help flight crews record trip data and perform standard checklists digitally.
insights.caveat: Details on specific airline deployments of this version are limited.

insights.title: TransNusa Adopts Navblue Skywise Solutions
insights.finding: TransNusa adopted Skywise Core X2 and S.FP+ to integrate its flight and technical operations.
insights.aviation_context: Integrated flight operations platforms combine maintenance data with active flight planning workflows.
insights.caveat: Represents regional adoption in the Asia-Pacific market.

monthly.main_movement: AvioBook released version 26.3, added airline notices to NOTAMs, and secured a major EFB agreement with Royal Air Maroc.

quarterly.main_movement: Aviobook promoted its upcoming Connect 3.0 release, updated EFB NOTAM modules, and signed Royal Air Maroc for the AvioBook Flight EFB.

yearly.main_movement: Aviobook expanded product capabilities through version updates, webinar previews for Connect 3.0, and a long-term EFB contract with Royal Air Maroc.

monthly.main_movement: Bytron Skybook released version 1.52.0 of its EFB and Ground Portal and highlighted multi-AOC operations for Texel Air.

quarterly.main_movement: Bytron Skybook promoted dispatcher messaging features and released EFB version 1.52.0 while highlighting Texel Air's platform usage.

yearly.main_movement: Bytron Skybook delivered regular EFB application updates and messaging enhancements connecting pilots and dispatchers.

monthly.main_movement: Captured movement and evidence are limited for the current monthly window.

quarterly.main_movement: IFS secured EFBOne platform deployments with MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air), fastjet, and TUS Airways.

yearly.main_movement: IFS expanded its EFBOne footprint by signing multiple regional and cargo carriers across international markets.

monthly.main_movement: Jeppesen unveiled Airflow dispatch agents for ForeFlight at NBAA-BACE 2026 and expanded its partnership with Saxon Air.

quarterly.main_movement: Jeppesen secured Department of Defense IL5 authorization for ForeFlight, expanded partnerships, and launched new dispatch Airflow agents.

yearly.main_movement: Jeppesen expanded its market presence through major fleet agreements with Korean Air and Corendon Airlines alongside defense authorizations and ForeFlight upgrades.

monthly.main_movement: Lufthansa Systems implemented Lido Flight 4D for Kenya Airways and promoted customer workflows for Lido mPilot and crew pairing.

quarterly.main_movement: Lufthansa Systems deployed Lido mPilot for Viva, implemented Lido Flight 4D for Kenya Airways, and released Lido mPilot 7.3.

yearly.main_movement: Lufthansa Systems advanced its flight planning and navigation portfolio through Lido Flight 4D enhancements, mPilot updates, and key airline implementations.

monthly.main_movement: Navblue secured a customer win with TransNusa for Skywise Core X2 and S.FP+ integration at MRO APAC.
